title: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM) progress
summary: Honey production: 1,51,690 MT (2025-26), up from 80,530 MT (2014-15).

items: Honey production: 1,51,690 MT (2025-26), up from 80,530 MT (2014-15).
India = **2nd-largest honey exporter globally** (from 9th in 2020); exported 1.07 lakh MT worth $177.55M (FY24).
NBHM outlay ₹500 Cr (FY21–FY26), via National Bee Board **Quick Hits (Tier B+):**.

Flipkart Minutes launches private label **'Pykd'** — piloted Bengaluru; rivals: Blinkit "Gourmet," Zepto "Select," Swiggy Instamart "Noice." FirstClub raised $55M Series B (Jun 2026). 🎯 Which co. launched Pykd? (Flipkart Minutes).

V.O. Chidambaranar Port (VOCPA) — **1st Indian port with ISO 50001:2018**; awarded by IRQS under Harit Sagar Green Port Guidelines; earlier: 1st Major Port with IGBC Platinum + BEE Shunya + Scope-2 emission-free. 🎯 🔥 HIGH — VOCPA "firsts" cluster.
MoPSW approves ₹334.89 Cr internal flyover, Visakhapatnam Port (3.584-km elevated corridor). Minister: Sarbananda Sonowal; MoS: Shantanu Thakur.
Gujarat approves 4 Centres of Excellence for natural farming — ₹20 Cr (2026-27); Navsari, Morbi, Bhavnagar, Chhota Udepur; agency: Gujarat Prakrutik Krishi Vikas Board.
Gross GST collections grew 15.4% to over ₹2.11 trillion (July 2026).
India's WPI moderated to 9.78% in July 2026 (from 9.87% in June).
India's Manufacturing GVA: FY26 growth 10.7%; CAGR 10.88% (FY23–FY26); HSBC Manufacturing PMI 53.5 (Jul 2026).
